info.title: API.SH: Docker Hub
info.description: The Docker Hub API from API.SH: public Docker Hub data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Docker Hub's image categories (slug and name), for the category filter of /dockerhub/v1/search.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/dockerhub-categories

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: Docker Hub overview and build steps
get.description:
A repository's full overview (README) and the build steps of one image of a tag: each layer's instruction and size, the steps joined as a Dockerfile-like text, the platform shown and the platforms available.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/dockerhub-dockerfile

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Image name or Docker Hub link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A Docker Hub user or organization: type, link, full name, company, location, website, join date and avatar, and its repositories (name, link, description, stars, pulls, dates, categories, storage). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/dockerhub-namespace

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Namespace (user or organization name) or its hub.docker.com link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One Docker Hub repository: name, namespace, link, pull command, type, description, official flag, status, stars, exact pull count, dates, storage size, categories, media and content types, tag count, the 10 latest tags (size, digest) and the overview (the repository's README, first 20,000 characters). With `vulnerabilities=true`, each latest tag also carries the vulnerability counts of its linux/amd64 image (critical, high, medium, low, unspecified, total), and `vulnerabilities` sums up the `latest` tag (or the newest tag); counts are null where the Hub shows none.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/dockerhub-repository

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Image name (`nginx` for an official image, or `namespace/name`) or a hub.docker.com link.

parameters.name: vulnerabilities
parameters.description: `true` adds vulnerability counts per latest tag and a `vulnerabilities` summary (may cost more).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

# Quick reference

get.description:
Images (and extensions and plugins) on Docker Hub matching a search and the Hub's filters: id, name, namespace, link, type, description, publisher, official, verified-publisher and open-source flags, stars, pull count band, dates (created, updated, last pushed and pulled), archived flag, categories, architectures, operating systems and logo. `total` is the number of matches. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/dockerhub-search

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

items.name: redis
items.description: Redis is the world's fastest data platform for caching, vector search, and NoSQL databases.

get.description:
One tag of an image: digest, media type, size, status, update, push and pull times, last updater, and every platform image (OS, architecture, variant, digest, size, push and pull times) with its layers (digest, size and the build instruction).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/dockerhub-tag

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Image name (nginx, bitnami/redis, nginx:alpine) or Docker Hub link.

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: Tag (default latest, or the one in name).

parameters.name: architecture
parameters.description: Only this architecture, e.g. amd64, arm64.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Tags of a Docker Hub repository: name, digest, size, last updated, pushed and pulled, status, media type, last updater and the image for each platform (architecture, variant, OS, digest, size, push and pull dates). With `vulnerabilities=true`, each platform image also carries its vulnerability counts (critical, high, medium, low, unspecified, total), null where the Hub shows none. `total` is the number of tags. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/dockerhub-tags

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Image name (`nginx` for an official image, or `namespace/name`) or a hub.docker.com link.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Only tags containing this text, e.g. `alpine`.

parameters.name: vulnerabilities
parameters.description: `true` adds vulnerability counts to each platform image (may cost more).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
